system_thesis_interpretation: The benchmark is intended to make a bounded version of the experiential-memory flywheel empirically necessary: a method's retained life-specific structure must alter an information-seeking action; that action must create a public event not already supplied by the deck; after the assigned memory is removed, target-blind revision of that event must improve a later fresh action; and the named frozen text system must acquire new mappings, retain earlier ones, and improve cross-era action after its native context. This is not a test of generic intelligence, human-like learning, compression, unbounded continual learning, controller training, or a parametric LoRA advantage. Its publication value comes from a difficult causal benchmark and a finite, failure-inclusive action-learning claim, conditional on the construct and comparison controls actually holding.
graph_delta_interpretation: The key benchmark repair replaces equal arm trajectories with equal presealed opportunities. Ordinary arms own their actions and public outcomes, so memory can change evidence acquisition, while the opportunity deck, latent roots, menus, caps, targets, and twin construction prevent treatment from choosing an easier world. At each strict post-native checkpoint, a byte-identical twin side splits into AUTH/TWIN/NULL diagnostic clones under opaque randomized assignment. The installed memory may change one probe only; it is then unmounted, the branch public event is compiled against a common authentic prior with assignment-independent paired compiler draws, and a sterile later target sees only that common prior plus its delta. Thus the intended identified path is assignment -> probe -> public evidence -> target-blind delta -> later action. It is a randomized chain-complete cascade, not a natural-indirect-effect or formal mediation estimand. The target itself must remain representation-neutral: no target can require a SELF record, while the A0/D4 proof must exclude target-only, direct witness, one-event, four-independent-key/value, and equal-atom nonadaptive solutions under the fixed online envelope. Recurrent KV, linked memory, raw RAG, mechanical memory, and SELF may all solve the world; the claimed incremental result, if any, is only generic world-family-blind SELF compilation over the strongest eligible same-history non-SELF comparator.
loop_delta_interpretation: The ordinary life is an on-policy growing stream: retrieve eligible arm memory, select diagnostic/instrumental actions within the fixed budget, observe public outcomes, perform prospective/revision sleep without target truth, and write a sealed memory snapshot. Sterile evaluation never writes back. The diagnostic pulse interrupts that loop only at registered checkpoints, records the exact three clones and reset receipts, and credits later action only if every preceding cumulative link survives. The second loop is an offline compiler-comparison loop: supplied deterministic extraction may parse public events, but the frozen generic model must own prospective claims and raw-outcome revision; raw replay, keyed witnesses, fixed programs, mechanical constructions, nonadaptive/recurrent readers, native external-memory candidates, linked/rolling representations, and a class-informed ceiling are all necessary alternatives rather than decorative ablations. The third loop is deliberately nonautomatic: A0--A2 certify the target, causal boundaries, and exact cognition bytes before model calls; B0--B3 are eight-root DEV; only a later separately authorized Stage C may run the 26-root text confirmation. LoRA is downstream of a successful powered text result and remains a separately authorized one-checkpoint DEV transport sentinel.
claim_delta_interpretation: The proposal correctly retires the fixed-source self-improvement claim. A valid positive could support only two headline-level, finite synthetic claims: (1) a randomized action-conditioned causal cascade in which unmounted, generic model-owned SELF compilation adds later world/action value beyond the declared same-event and common-history controls, subject to binding/outcome/semantic interventions; and (2) a named frozen text-memory system that acquires, retains, and improves cross-era D4 action through the three post-native checkpoints. Both require the full future confirmation, not DEV. Baseline plateau is optional and requires an equivalence result for an exact named baseline, not a visual flattening or PCFL superiority. A4's current role is integrity-only: all assigned rows, representation-neutral action scoring, zero-inclusive failures, and sterility are mandatory, but positive revision or recovery efficacy is descriptive and cannot strengthen P1--P4. Stage-D LoRA is not applicable to current text claims; no absence of LoRA evidence can block C1--C3, and no LoRA, compression, unbounded-learning, or broad SOTA claim is permitted.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The benchmark's causal reading depends on full descendant taint closure, not merely hiding a treatment label. Hidden truth certificates and sterile evaluation goal/outcome are forbidden to all proposal, compiler, reader, wake, and branch components; evaluation queries are ephemeral and cannot persist. Fork assignment metadata and assigned semantic memory are visible only where needed to install, audit, and prove removal, never to the actor/compiler descendants whose bytes or seeds would thereby become treatment descendants. The postfork resetter may verify metadata-level removal but must not interpret treatment semantics; the delta compiler receives the branch public event and common authentic prior, not the installed treatment or opaque label. P1 paired seeds must exclude treatment, branch, label, lane, and assignment metadata, and cut/sham lanes must not resample. Common-history lanes must differ only in their predeclared representation/compiler policy. The DEV selector sees only sealed allowed aggregates and can emit one immutable configuration without rewriting cognition; fresh lives must clear registries, caches, candidate/error/timing channels, and cross-life state. Any violation, including a semantic residue, goal persistence, or unequal non-delta input, invalidates the credited contrast rather than being adjusted away.
acceptance_test_interpretation: T01 is the construct-totality gate: preseal all opportunities/targets/twins, use the 0.75L NEW/reference cohort without retention language, enforce post-native OLD/CROSS ages, and demonstrate growing unique causal information. T02 is the decisive shortcut gate: certify legal D4 action headroom and representation-neutral integrative targets, rejecting target-only/Bayes, direct-record, one-event, independent lookup, and equal-atom nonadaptive solutions without outlawing recurrent or non-SELF memory. T03 tests the exact AUTH/TWIN/NULL, unmount, common-prior, CRN, same-event, matched-action, binding, semantic-cut, and failure-inclusive P1 cascade; it supports no formal-mediation wording. T04 establishes that a frozen generic model, rather than parsing, a verifier, raw event replay, or keyed witness, owns the claimed offline revision and that all model calls/resources are charged. T05 requires legitimate context, RAG, witness KV, native external memory, exact-program, mechanical, generic SELF, and class-informed-ceiling baselines under common-history isolation, with only the sealed one-way AS-EXT selector. T06 makes twin-pair root the independent unit and requires all 908 rows/root, four failure-inclusive composites, the 26-root alpha-.05 complete-intersection IUT, simultaneous SD-UCB, and prospective simulation; 26 is a design commitment, not achieved power until the diagnostics pass. T07 mutation-tests every information/stage and metadata/seed/cache/reset channel. T08 prevents a calendar or budget from silently pruning the surface: September 25 is A0--A2/B0--B3 construct-plus-DEV only, while the 23,608-row Stage C must separately fit the 520-H100-equivalent/6.5-TB and review/retry caps. T09 requires A4 roster/scoring/failure/sterility integrity but leaves efficacy descriptive. T10 is correctly recorded NOT_REQUESTED_STAGE_D for current C1--C3 and becomes mandatory only inside a future ratified LoRA claim. T11 requires a fresh reproduction/claim reviewer and preserves the claim firewall. T12 freezes prompts, parser, model/sampling, reader, cuts, CRN implementation, caps, and failure mapping before any scientific model call; any revision restarts DEV and requires new review and authority.
assumptions: The presealed generator can produce enough causal-map diversity, exact tokenizer-valid rows, and representation-neutral D4 targets for the 0.75L and 3L/6L schedules without using target truth in any method-visible path.

The registered multi-public-event D4 certificate genuinely rules out the named nonadaptive and target-only closures under the same six-read, 4,096-query-byte, 16,384-return-byte, twelve-operation envelope, while allowing legitimate recurrent/KV/linked competitors.

Opaque labels, clone order, unmount receipts, paired compiler RNG, no-resample cut/sham behavior, and all metadata descendants can be implemented and mutation-tested exactly rather than asserted from logs.

The generic SELF compiler, event extractor, reader policies, semantic cuts, and all comparator interfaces can be frozen at A2 before any scientific model output, so DEV cannot select cognition post hoc.

The specified full-surface comparators can be run under their legitimate interfaces and budgets; a root-wise strongest eligible baseline envelope remains available after common-history isolation rather than being weakened by a shared artificial cap.

The 26 fresh twin-pair roots, 908 rows/root, resource ledger, 100,000-plus nested simulations, and independent review can be completed only after the stated Stage-C authority and resource/calendar feasibility gates pass.

ambiguities.question: Which exact frozen generic model, two native external-memory candidates, and legitimate resource policies will be selected at A2, and can each satisfy the common-history and reader-interface requirements without preferential engineering?
ambiguities.impact: Until those bytes and policies are frozen, the strongest-baseline envelope and model-owned comparison are not operationally determined.

ambiguities.question: Will the executable D4 falsifier establish that no target-only or nonadaptive retrieval strategy succeeds while preserving enough legitimate headroom for all declared baseline families?
ambiguities.impact: Failure either collapses construct validity or makes the benchmark needlessly SELF-specific; neither outcome can support the advertised compiler advantage.

ambiguities.question: Can the full component matrix prove semantic unmount and metadata closure, especially across stochastic compiler samples, caches, timing/errors, and fresh-life reset?
ambiguities.impact: An unproven descendant path would make the observed later-action contrast compatible with direct treatment leakage rather than reconsolidated evidence.

ambiguities.question: Can the measured confirmation roster, including clones, lagged/current snapshots, failure rows, storage, retries, review, and transfer, fit the 520-H100-equivalent and 6.5-TB caps after DEV without pruning?
ambiguities.impact: If not, Stage C must stop or be separately redesigned; the eight-root DEV result cannot be promoted to a paper claim.

ambiguities.question: Will the frozen variance diagnostics and scenario simulation satisfy their simultaneous SD-UCB, size, and joint-power rules for the four root composites?
ambiguities.impact: The stated marginal and dependence-free planning numbers do not substitute for a passing prospective diagnostic or observed complete-intersection decision.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The phrase 'causal cascade' is acceptable only as a descriptive chain claim; it risks being read as formal mediation or as identification of the unique cognitive mechanism.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: AUTH/TWIN/NULL plus unmount and common-prior deltas block the direct assigned-memory path, but the design does not identify a natural indirect effect and recurrent/linked representations may legitimately match SELF.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Keep the exact 'chain-complete causal cascade, not formal mediation' qualifier in all claims and require P1's cumulative links, same-event/common-history controls, and interventions before any causal wording.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: A successful SELF condition alone would not establish a compelling benchmark contribution if raw, recurrent KV, linked, mechanical, or a legitimate native external-memory baseline matches it under the same history and online budget.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The construct is representation-neutral by design, so the paper cannot define success as SELF use; it needs the predeclared root-wise strongest comparator envelope and the common-history killer to establish an incremental compiler result.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Treat a matching eligible baseline as a null for the SELF compilation-advantage claim, report it fully, and retain only any supported architecture-neutral construct or diagnostic result.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The 26-root plan is a defensible prospective design, not evidence that the final experiment is powered or feasible today.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Joint power depends on the frozen variance bounds and simulation, while cost depends on measured full-roster execution including failures, snapshots, storage, and review; the current deadline explicitly excludes confirmation.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Do not describe B-stage DEV as confirmation or use planned power as achieved power; run Stage C only after its diagnostic, resources, schedule, review, and new exact authority are satisfied.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: A4 should not be rhetorically presented as a validation of revision efficacy for the current text paper.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The applicability contract makes it integrity-only: an efficacy value of zero does not fail C1--C3, and P1--P4 cannot change because of its mechanism diagnostics.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Report A4 completeness, representation-neutral scoring, failures, and sterility as mandatory; label detection, revision, recovery, and unrelated-retention values descriptive until a separate powered A4 proposal exists.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The stated September 25 goal cannot honestly be a complete paper-evidence milestone.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The binding documents restrict it to ordered construct certification and labeled eight-root DEV; confirmation, independent reproduction, and any LoRA path are later gated work.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Use the deadline only for a verified benchmark/DEV package and preserve the nonconfirmatory label in every artifact, figure, and claim draft.
